name: NCL Research and Financial Services Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1985, NCL Research and Financial Services Ltd is engaged in the business of finance and investments in capital market.
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company is registered with Reserve Bank of India as a Non Deposit Non Banking Financial Corp. Company trades/invests in both Equity and FnO segment and also trades in Commodities market apart from Financial activities.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.47 times its book value
cons: Company has a low return on equity of 0.28% over last 3 years.
Company has high debtors of 153 days.
